plant.fitted_to: Boot9 four-hour trace; last chronological quarter held out
plant.notes: Approximate input/output fit, not isolated valve calibration. Random delay, dead time, pressure, noise and leakage are stress hypotheses. Pending plant gas continues after valve cutoff.

stress.limits: Stress failures are retained. Simulation cannot guarantee unknown cylinder flow, mixing changes or a stuck valve. A notified cylinder change resets learning; an unannounced abrupt pressure change is only observable after gas reaches the sensor.

current_log_fit.model: Two exponential state impulse response; gain times max(duration-dead,0)**power. Constant leak decay, transport, mixing. Fit actual pulses; chronologic holdout. Not an isolated physical calibration.

interpretation: Attribution/queued quantities improve nominal simulation, but door and cylinder recovery still fail. No new upload, ON/OFF or ACK. Maintenance prototype is limited to 1000ppm headroom and uses commanded milliseconds per elapsed time; not a physically verified loss estimate. The fitted log has about1206ppm chronological holdout RMSE, greater than the1000ppm half-band; it cannot certify maintenance in-band. Candidate stores first arrival timing only, not a validated adaptive delay model. Queued commands may be overwritten after five outstanding openings.
